label: Blocket

discovery.auth: JWT in X-Auth-Token, issued by Blocket customer support (dealer_code scope)

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Blocket Pro Import API v4 lets dealers create/update/delete their own Blocket and Bytbil ads; explicitly not for powering search sites; no public search API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://api.blocket.se/pro-import-api/docs/client-documentation): Blocket Pro Import API v4 lets dealers create/update/delete their own Blocket and Bytbil ads; explicitly not for powering search sites; no public search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
